description: Choose between a relaunch, a regular update, or more preparation from the size of the change and launch evidence you provide. Use it when you have already launched and are unsure whether to relaunch, post a regular update, or prepare more first. Returns one of three verdicts (plan a relaunch, publish a regular update, prepare before promoting) with the reasons and next actions, based only on the answers given. Returns an evidence-bounded result and the canonical web tool URL.

audienceChanged.description: yes if the people you are targeting are different from the last launch.

change.description: Size of the biggest change since your last launch: small is incremental improvements, major is a new workflow or a new audience, direction is a different product direction.

evidence.description: What you can show for the update: strong is a working release plus specific proof such as a demo or numbers, release is a working release only, none means it is not released yet.

listingCurrent.description: yes if your public listing, screenshots and facts already match the product as it is today.

measurementReady.description: yes if tracking, support ownership and a review date are already in place for the announcement.

name: toolfound_relaunch_decision
title: Relaunch decision checker
